Flight Planning

carburante alternato in rotta

Fuel required to fly from the destination to an alternate aerodrome en‑route under planned conditions.

Questions and answers

What is carburante alternato in rotta?

In this glossary, carburante alternato in rotta refers to: Fuel required to fly from the destination to an alternate aerodrome en‑route under planned conditions.

How is carburante alternato in rotta used in aviation?

Definition

Fuel required to fly from the destination to an alternate aerodrome en‑route under planned conditions.

Operational example

Dispatcher: Include en‑route alternate fuel sufficient to reach the alternate airport under planned en‑route conditions.

Localized term

carburante alternato in rotta

Localized example

Pianificatore: includi carburante alternato in rotta sufficiente per raggiungere l’aeroporto alternato secondo le condizioni pianificate.
